text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, perfect timing! About the 
next issue of Monthly Twinkle—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Please, by all means!! We would love to do 
a special feature on you, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Dedicating yourself day and night to your 
trainee Umamusume, never ceasing your 
efforts for even a moment... Such 
dedication...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
A pile of read papers that easily towers 
over the Tokyo Racecourse grandstand, 
coupled with the stamina to keep pace with 
a horse girl's running—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that even amidst the cheers of 
nearly 200,000 spectators, you can 
distinguish the breathing of your 
dedicated Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... How marvelous!! If we're doing a 
special feature, it simply has to be you! 
Please, I'm counting on you!!
